descriptionFull: The five-striped sparrow ( Amphispizopsis quinquestriata ) is a medium-sized sparrow. It is the only member of the genus Amphispizopsis . It was formerly classified in the genus Amphispiza with the black-throated sparrow ( Amphispiza bilineata ).
